<article title="Product care">
Wash technical shells and down jackets on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash, never regular detergent, and tumble dry on low. Down jackets need two or three clean tennis balls in the dryer to restore loft.

Waterproof coatings wear down with use. If water stops beading on a shell, wash it and apply a spray-on re-proofing treatment; this restores the coating without affecting the warranty.

Store sleeping bags and down items uncompressed in a dry place. Long-term compression permanently reduces insulation.

</article>

Customer first name: Leilani
<request>
coating peeling
the waterproof coating inside my jacket is peeling off in sheets after one season. is that wear or a defect?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Leilani,

Thanks for reaching out about your jacket. According to our care guidelines, waterproof coatings do wear down with normal use. If water stops beading on your shell, you can wash it and apply a spray-on re-proofing treatment to restore the coating without affecting your warranty.

However, peeling in sheets after one season may indicate something beyond typical wear. A specialist will follow up with you to assess your specific situation.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
